json.invalid: Not saved — this is not valid JSON: {error}

gapSays: The missing word in brackets: “To be, or [[not]] to be” — the learner sees “…” and types the word. Several gaps: the answer is the words in order.
answersGap: Other good answers (without them — the word from the brackets)
answers: Good answers — the first is the model
orderItems: Items in the right order — the learner will see them shuffled

code.testsHint: [{"input": [3, 1, 2], "output": [1, 2, 3], "note": "ascending"}] — transform(input) must give output; checked before the hidden cases.

hints: Hints — before the answer, from gentle to specific (each lowers the score by ¼)
shareGap: Several gaps: each word is a separate part.
shareHint: Questions about the same part (the same “Shared parts” name, the same fact) count answers together — one answer is enough for both cards to know.
whyGood: Why it's right — a sentence after answering
whyNot: Why not — a sentence after answering
gaps: Gaps — to type or to choose
gapPh: to type — or wrong options: Lemma 2.1 | Satz 3.4
gapHint: A gap with options is a list to choose from (formulas $…$ allowed); without them — a field to type in. Each gap counts separately.
tiles: Tiles of the good answer — in the right order (formulas: $…$)
alternatives: Other good orders — one per line, tiles separated by “|”
params: Parameters — a new task with each question
paramsHint: [{"name": "a", "random": [20, 99]}, {"name": "f", "values": ["sin", "cos"]}, {"name": "kation", "entry": {"kind": "@chem/jon", "where": "it.ladunek > 0"}}, {"name": "zd", "entries": {"kind": "@hist/zdarzenie", "count": 4}}] — in texts {a}, {kation.symbol}; an entry has fields (entry.field), id, label
letHint: [{"name": "r", "value": "mod(a, n)"}, {"name": "pierwsze", "value": "minby(zd, it.data).label"}] — the drawing expression language with lists: [a, b], xs[0], filter, map, sortby, choose, gcd, lcm, sub, sup …; in texts {r}; a list in “options”: "{zle}" — each item separately
require: Draw conditions (it draws again until all hold — at most 60 times; otherwise no card is made)
scripts: sub/superscripts (₂, ²) like plain digits — Al2(SO4)3 = Al₂(SO₄)₃
pasteHint: One pair per line. Sides are separated by a tab (from a spreadsheet), “ – ”, “ | ”, “;” or “=”.
showPairs: Pairs at once on a card
pairsShow: — {show} per card: each pair has its own card, with {others} others beside it, at random. In a review the pairs you don't know yet come back.
showSentences: Sentences at once on a card
sentences: Each sentence counts separately: correctly marked or correctly left out; the score is the average.
sentencesShow: {show} per card: each sentence has its own card (with {others} others beside it, at least one good). In a review the sentences you don't know yet come back.
previewTitle: This is how the learner will see it
incomplete: The card will appear once the question is complete.
